title: Circuit diagram with a voltage source, ammeter, and resistors
components: A battery with positive and negative terminals
A switch labeled K, which is closed
An ammeter (A) in series with the battery
A 2 ohm resistor in series with the ammeter
Two 4 ohm resistors connected in parallel with each other
A voltmeter (V) connected in parallel with the two 4 ohm resistors
key_features: The circuit is a series-parallel combination circuit.
The 2 ohm resistor is in series with the parallel combination of the two 4 ohm resistors.
The voltmeter measures the voltage drop across the parallel network of resistors.
The ammeter measures the total current flowing out of the battery.
